title: MarsRecon: Self-Supervised and Multimodal Surface Representations for Mars
abstract: arXiv:2609.22379v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-resolution orbital imagery offers a rich record of the Martian surface, but sparse geological labels limit supervised representation learning. We present MarsRecon, a geospatially aware pipeline for learning visual and multimodal representations from HiRISE observations of Olympus Mons. The pipeline calibrates NASA Planetary Data System products, extracts valid georeferenced patches, and trains a masked autoencoder on unlabeled imagery. Increasing input resolution and filtering invalid tokens reduced held-out reconstruction loss from 0.1751 to 0.1342 in the principal Stage A model series. We then freeze the visual encoder and align its features with observation text, coordinates, and local--global image context. The strongest current local-primary model achieves image-to-text recall@10 of 0.3787, text-to-image recall@10 of 0.9161, and local-to-global recall@10 of 0.4350 on the held-out test split. translated_title: MarsRecon：面向火星的自监督多模态地表表示学习
translated_abstract: 高分辨率轨道影像为火星表面提供了丰富的记录，但稀疏的地质标注限制了有监督表示学习的发展。我们提出了MarsRecon，这是一个具有地理空间感知能力的流水线，用于从奥林帕斯山（Olympus Mons）的HiRISE观测数据中学习视觉与多模态表示。该流水线对NASA行星数据系统（PDS）产品进行校准，提取有效的地理参考图像块，并在无标注影像上训练掩码自编码器。在主要的Stage A模型系列中，提高输入分辨率并过滤无效token使留出集上的重建损失从0.1751降至0.1342。随后我们冻结视觉编码器，并将其特征与观测文本、坐标以及局部-全局图像上下文进行对齐。当前最强的以局部为主的模型在留出测试集上实现了图像到文本recall@10为0.3787、文本到图像recall@10为0.9161、局部到全局recall@10为0.4350。这些结果建立了一个可用的（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: MarsRecon提出了一个地理空间感知的自监督流水线，通过对奥林帕斯山HiRISE影像训练掩码自编码器，并将其特征与文本、坐标及局部-全局上下文对齐，实现了无需地质标注的火星表面视觉与多模态表示学习。
en_tdlr: MarsRecon introduces a geospatially aware self-supervised pipeline that trains a masked autoencoder on unlabeled HiRISE imagery of Olympus Mons and aligns its features with text, coordinates, and local-global image context, enabling label-free visual and multimodal representation learning of the Martian surface.
